d: Chestnut brown hair is styled with long, flowing locks, blunt-cut bangs, and a braided section tied with a yellow ribbon. The eyes are a deep amber shade with a bright, energetic expression, set on a face with the apparent maturity of a late adolescent. The build is slender, dressed in a white off-the-shoulder kimono-style top with red trim, a dark brown pleated mini-skirt, and matching brown thigh-high stockings. Signature details include a golden braided cord accessory across the chest and mechanical grey battleship rigging attached to the back.
